meta.title: R8 two-letter kernels: final agreed results (revision of 2026-10-29)
meta.unit: u = hbar tr_g(ad_X ad_Y)/(16 pi^2 (X,Y)) = -g^2 N/(32 pi^2) for su(N), (X,Y) = -(4 hbar/g^2) tr(XY)
meta.stripped_unit: engine table values are in units hbar/(16 pi^2) for the colour element (1 (x) w)(-,-)^{-1}, w = ad_{Y_r}...ad_{Y_1}, Y_1 nearest X_a; a planar adjacent pair of a su(N) single trace gives (-1)^r (value/2) u with the pair replaced by Y_1...Y_r
meta.conventions: Euclidean R^4, weight e^{S/hbar}, P(eps,T) = int_eps^T (Q^GF (x) 1) K_t dt, per-edge cutoff t_e >= eps, T = infinity at generic momenta (Prop prop:tl-map (iii), Prop c8-Tsafe), no dimensional regularisation, no IR regulator besides T; manuscript notation (V, W_R^perp, Sigma, rho, Gamma), letters A|_V, A|_perp, lambda_+-, c and antifields; two-component form by Def c8-twocomp
meta.notation_map_engine_strings: engine A closed-form strings use the engine variables s, u (point splitting), sigma = u - s, c(alpha), E = number of edges; theory: y_a, y_b, y_ab = y_b - y_a, l_0(alpha), k+1

decomposition.abstract: d_delta I^CT[eps](M) = hbar Sing_eps d_{P_e(eps,T)} M |_{e=fields} = sum_{a<b} (-1)^{n_ab} int omega X_1...K_eps(X_a,X_b)...(X_b omitted)...X_n,  n_ab = |X_b|(|X_{a+1}|+...+|X_{b-1}|);  no one-body terms
decomposition.kernel: K_eps(X_a,X_b) = hbar Sing_eps [(d^alpha_x (x) d^beta_y) P_e(eps,T)^{phi_a phi_b}(x,y)]_{y=x}, P_e = sum_k P (I_e P)^k = hbar Sing <X_a(x) X_b(y)>_e (Lemma lem:tl-sign)
decomposition.two_component: same sum over pairs; kernel = hbar Sing of the point-split dressed propagator <X_a(x) X_b(y)>_e with <A_m A_n> = 2(-,-)^{-1} delta_mn, <A_ij A_kl> = 4(-,-)^{-1} eps_ijkl, <c A*_m> = -(-,-)^{-1} i p_m, <lambda_alpha^i lambdabar_{alphadot j}> = -(-,-)^{-1} p_m sigma^m delta^i_j, times (e^{-eps p^2} - e^{-T p^2})/p^2

counterterm_map.sign_of_odd_pairs: Hessian-of-M supertrace = (-1)^{|X_a|+|X_b|} K (Lemma lem:tl-sign); engine A derives it, engine B equals it entrywise (status proved; computed_2)
counterterm_map.singular_terms: only eps^{-m} (1 <= m <= w_M/2) and log eps; ct_m of weight w_M - 2m, lc of weight w_M; T-independent; scaling (v. - 4 eps d/deps) d_delta I^CT(M) = d_delta I^CT(v.M) - 4 lc(M) (Prop prop:tl-map, proved)
counterterm_map.finite_special_edge_vertex: -sum_m ((-1)^m/m!) ({I, ct_m(M)}_{H^m} + {ct_m(I), M}_{H^m}), {,}_{H^m} from (H^m (x) 1)K_0 (eq tl-finitesp; scheme dependent, enters L_1)

k0.formula: K^(0)(d^alpha phi_a, d^beta phi_b) = hbar Phat (-1)^{|beta|} (d^{alpha+beta} S_eps)(0), (d^gamma S_eps)(0) = (-1)^{m+1}/(16 pi^2 m 2^{m-1} eps^m) sum_{pairings of gamma} prod delta, |gamma| = 2(m-1)
k0.content: single power eps^{-w_ab/2}; zero for odd w_ab; no log, no finite part

simplex.formula: 16 pi^2 [eps^-m] = (1/m) int_Delta (min_e alpha_e)^m F_m dalpha, 16 pi^2 [log eps] = -int_Delta F_0 dalpha, F_m = sum_{m_j >= m} num_j (-Phi)^{m_j-m}/(m_j-m)!, num_j = (Lap^j N)(l_0)/(j! 4^j), m_j = j+1-k, l_0 = -sum alpha_j R_j, Phi = sum alpha_j |R_j|^2 - |l_0|^2

closed_forms.shape: log eps independent of the cutoff shape chi; eps^{-m} and finite part depend on it (Prop prop:tl-shape)
closed_forms.special_edge: no log eps; [eps^0] = -int_{R_s} F_0 log(alpha_s/min_{f != s} alpha_f) (Lemma lem:tl-special); toy: -1/(2 eps) - 3|p|^2/8
closed_forms.generating_function: F_m^gen = (-1)^q e^{i(y_ab,l_0)} (|y_ab|/(2 sqrt Phi))^q I_q(|y_ab| sqrt Phi), q = m+k-1; sum y_a^alpha y_b^beta/(alpha! beta!) [log]K(d^alpha phi_a, d^beta phi_b) = -(hbar/16pi^2) e^{i(y_b,R)} N_V(-i d_{y_ab}) int_Delta F_0^gen; eps^{-m}: (hbar/(16 pi^2 m)) e^{i(y_b,R)} N_V(-i d_{y_ab}) int_Delta (min alpha)^m F_m^gen; iR = d on the product of the outputs

bubble_closed_form.formula: 16 pi^2 [log eps] = -sum_{n1,n2,j} (i(y_a,R))^{n1} (i(y_b,R))^{n2} |y_ab|^{2j} (|R|^2/4)^j (n1+j)!(n2+j)!/(n1! n2! (j!)^2 (n1+n2+2j+1)!)  (constant N_V: quartic bubbles)
bubble_closed_form.example: (d_mu phi_a, d_nu phi_b) of a quartic bubble -> (hbar/16pi^2) log eps (-1/6 d_mu d_nu - 1/12 delta_mu nu box)(Psi_1 Psi_2) x (colour, fibre factor)
bubble_closed_form.checks: 1350 checks against engine A quartic blocks with up to 3 derivatives (qa/compare); engine A n <= 4

engine_A_strings.k=1, constant chain numerator N_V (quart: 16 pi^2 [log] = -N_V sum_{a,b,j} (i(s,R))^a (i(u,R))^b |u-s|^{2j} (|R|^2/4)^j (a+j)!(b+j)!/(a! b! (j!)^2 (a+b+2j+1)!), point splitting X_a(x+s) X_b(x+u), R = total output momentum; N_V = minus the W_0 log value of the bubble.

census.bound: eps^{-m}: weight w_ab - 2m, log: weight w_ab; n_out <= w_out + d_ab <= w_ab + d_ab; k <= n_out (Prop prop:tl-bound)

kernels_W0.description: exact two-letter kernels at w_ab = w^0_ab for all 21 pair types: every log / eps^{-m} leg set, ordered word, block structure, letter and output component, output-momentum polynomial (engine A basis, meta.components); equal to engine B entry by entry (389/389 rows; rerun 2026-10-29: 389/389)

basis.engine: A (route A: Schwinger-parameter Gaussian generating functions, exact simplex and boundary-face integrals)
basis.units: every coefficient is in units hbar/(16 pi^2), vertex scales divided out, for the colour element sum_gamma t^gamma (x) W(t_gamma), W = ad_{Y_k} ... ad_{Y_1} (Y_1 = first output, nearest to letter a); tr_g(ad_X ad_Y)/(X,Y) times this = units of u.  su(N) planar adjacent pair of tr(... X_a X_b ...): (-1)^r (value/2) u times tr(... Y_1 ... Y_r ...), u = -g^2 N/(32 pi^2)
basis.kernel: K(X_a,X_b) intrinsic (Def def:tl-dressed): (-1)^{|X_a|+|X_b|} times the str value with the operator Hessian (d_j d_l(delta M) = (-1)^{|M|(|j|+|l|)} delta d_j d_l M); for M = int omega (zeta_a, X_a)(zeta_b, X_b) the pair contributes zeta_a^T K zeta_b
basis.momenta: r{j}_{mu}: incoming momentum of output j (chain order from letter a), mu = 0..3 = engine A directions M = 0..3 (two-component index m = mu+1); i r <-> d acting on that output in position space
basis.components: index string "ia,ib,io1,io2,..." = basis vectors of ea_core.BASIS: AV, AsV: M = 0..3; AW, AsW: M = 4..9 (SO(6) index I = M-3); lamP/lamM: 8 integer vectors spanning the +1/-1 eigenspaces of rho(v1v2v3v4) = s0 sb1 s2 sb3 on Sigma (S_+ (x) W / S_- (x) W^*); lamsP/lamsM: +1/-1 on Sigma^* (S_+ (x) W^* / S_- (x) W); Clifford matrices of src.nosync/vendor/cliff.py; their two-component (Weinberg-Srednicki) form is the intertwiner U of step2/notation/check_dictionary.py (checks A1-A3)
basis.topology: block structure of the chain from a to b: C = cubic vertex with one output, Q = quartic vertex with two consecutive outputs; every internal line type summed
basis.regulator: per-edge Schwinger cutoff t_e >= eps, T = infinity (generic momenta); no dimensional regularisation
basis.revision_2026-10-29: qa/disposition.json: gates G3-W2, G3-W2n, G8f added; D_1 labels; planar scalar sector entries for D_1, P_1

invariant_forms_bosonic.notation:
Engine A: index-free (invariant) form of the bosonic W_0 kernels.  For pair types and words whose letters and outputs
are all bosonic with vector indices (AV, AsV: SO(4) index m; AW, AsW: SO(6) index I; c, cs: none), every table entry
polynomial is fitted exactly onto the basis of O(4) x O(6) invariant structures (Kronecker deltas among the slots,
slots contracted with output momenta r_j, scalar products r_i.r_j) and the fit is verified on every entry.  Structures
are printed as d(x,y) (delta), x.rj, rj.rk with slots a, b (letters) and o1, o2, ... (outputs in chain order).
